findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: invoice_anomaly_check · Private data: get_oman_company_profile, search_oman_company, invoice_anomaly_check, document_facts_extract, vehicle_value_estimate, analyze_oman_property, oman_supplier_check, supplier_due_diligence_report, strategy_performance_analysis, trade_log_analysis, ai_call_agent · Public sink: news_video_generate, product_promo_video, social_video_generate, business_90_day_growth_plan, sales_response_builder · Destructive: supplier_due_diligence_report, preview_capability.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: invoice_anomaly_check · Private data: get_oman_company_profile, search_oman_company, invoice_anomaly_check, document_facts_extract, vehicle_value_estimate, analyze_oman_property, oman_supplier_check, supplier_due_diligence_report, strategy_performance_analysis, trade_log_analysis, ai_call_agent · Public sink: news_video_generate, product_promo_video, social_video_generate, business_90_day_growth_plan, sales_response_builder · Destructive: supplier_due_diligence_report, preview_capability

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
